sections.heading: Examples
sections.text: Das Halteverbot gilt für alle, ausgenommen Linienbusse. :: The no-stopping rule applies to everyone except scheduled buses. Die Durchfahrt ist verboten, Anlieger ausgenommen. :: No through traffic, residents excepted.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: Very common on extra plates under traffic signs. It can come before or after the noun. Anlieger frei says the same thing for residents.
